Guides
Guides that stand on their own: getting started, principles, theming, and working with AI. Each topic keeps its own
name; open one by it.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

Topics

author-a-theme          Create, customize, and build a theme: defineTheme, palette generation, token overrides,
                        component style overrides, custom variants, responsive adaptations, and production builds.
browser-support         What browsers Astryx targets, which modern platform features it depends on, and how to support
                        older browsers for your own audience.
getting-started         Add the design system to your project and start building.
is-my-code-good         Check whether a product surface fits its app and uses Astryx well, require evidence for every
                        claim, and improve it with a repeatable agent review.
principles              Core design principles and rules for building with the design system.
styling-overview        How to set up CSS - exact imports for three paths: plain, Tailwind, and StyleX for your own code
                        - plus the stylesheet each Astryx package ships.
theme                   How to use and create themes: see Use a theme for applying themes, and Author a theme for
                        creating and customizing them.
use-a-theme             Apply a theme to your app: install, import with the CLI, wire the generated module, switch dark
                        mode, nest themes, and choose runtime or built for production.
use-integrations        Install, discover, and use integration packages that add components, templates, themes, and docs
                        to your app.
working-with-ai         How to set up AI coding tools to generate correct component code.
acme-guide (@acme/kit)  How zorblax cards fit together.

Open one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs <name>
Up: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs
stderr: Next step: run `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init` to finish setup and install the Astryx agent prompt.
